title: Monthly Membership – Cone 10 Gas and Electric Firing Access
evidence_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply). The opportunity to learn to fire kilns and fire your own work (become kiln certified with us to have full control of firing your pieces).
evidence_sentence: Monthly members have 24/7 studio access and can fire work in cone 10 gas or cone 6 electric kilns for $0.06/cubic inch, with optional kiln certification.
how_to_join: Apply through website; current wait time approximately 3 months
source_quote: Have your work fired in our cone 6 electric or cone 10 gas kilns (firing fees apply).
summary: Monthly membership ($150–$300/month, 6-month minimum) includes 24/7 studio access and cone 10 gas or cone 6 electric firing for $0.06/cubic inch. Optional kiln certification available.
